CFP-17.criterion: The organizer can create a second event and reach both events through an events list or event switcher.

CFP-18.criterion: Submissions, sessions, and speakers from one event are absent from another event.

EMB-15.criterion: Organizer embed/share administration generates configured snippets or share URLs per widget; full proof includes multiple output formats and a live interactive different-origin embed.
